info.title: Loro current API
info.description: Observed development API. No authentication, tenant isolation or durable storage. Not for multi-user deployment.

get.description: No auth. Liveness is independent of dependencies.
503 is JSON checks, not RFC 9457. Content and WASM only.
Real membership counts; no ETag or Cache-Control.
from is parsed with parseInt; older versions receive whole catalog; from=0 requests resync; no history.
Unknown pack returns 422; preserves authored membership order.

post.description: Nest default 201. Unscoped memory. Partial rejection: schema_unknown or VALIDATION_FAILED. Field HLC objects. Input checks are incomplete; schema describes intended well-formed calls, not all accidentally accepted inputs.
Ignores since and limit; every process row; no tenant scope; next is a placeholder HLC.
WASM availability and global row count; not production sync health.
JSON only; optional level ignored. Stub or bundled fallback, no live provider or budgets.
